units.en: Dezong ascended the throne in Dali 14 and changed the era name to Jianzhong the following year. At that time the shortened-month mourning regulation was in force, so he performed the ceremony in cap and robe.
units.literal: Dezong ascended the throne in the fourteenth year of Dali; the next year he changed the era name to Jianzhong; at the time the shortened-month regulation was in force; therefore he performed the affair in cap and robe.

units.zh: 今陛下退朝之服，盡如禮製，謂當供張別殿，遣三公奉冊，冊藏於有司，恭俟來歸。
units.en: Now Your Majesty's dress after retiring from court fully follows ritual regulation. I propose that a separate hall be prepared, the Three Ducal Ministers be dispatched to present the patent, the patent be stored with the relevant offices, and the ceremony await her return with all due respect.
units.literal: Now Your Majesty's dress after retiring from court fully follows ritual regulation; I say that a separate hall should be set out, the Three Ducal Ministers dispatched to present the patent, the patent stored with the relevant offices, and respectfully awaited until her return.

units.zh: 願下禮官講明。”
units.en: I ask that the ritual officers be ordered to clarify this matter."
units.literal: I wish that ritual officers below be ordered to clarify this."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: An edict approved the proposal.
units.literal: An edict followed this.

units.zh: 禮部、太常言：“寶文欲乞以‘ 皇太后寶’四字為文，合差撰冊文官一員，書冊文官一員，書篆寶文官一員，並差執政。”
units.en: The Ministry of Rites and the Temple of Rites reported: "For the seal inscription we request the four characters 'Empress Dowager's Seal.' One official should be assigned to draft the patent text, one to inscribe it, and one to inscribe the seal text in seal script; all should be drawn from the chief ministers."
units.literal: The Ministry of Rites and the Temple of Rites said: "For the seal inscription we wish to request using the four characters 'Empress Dowager's Seal' as the text; in all one official should be assigned to draft the patent text, one to inscribe the patent text, and one to inscribe the seal text in seal script; all should be drawn from the chief ministers."

units.zh: 十年，營建皇太后宮，以慈寧為名。
units.en: In the tenth year, the empress dowager's palace was built and named Cining.
units.literal: In the tenth year, the empress dowager's palace was constructed, taking Cining as its name.

units.zh: 十二月，帝自常禦殿詣慈寧殿遙賀皇 太后，奉上冊寶。
units.en: In the twelfth month the emperor proceeded from Changyu Hall to Cining Hall to offer congratulations from afar to the empress dowager and present the patent and seal.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, the emperor, from Changyu Hall, proceeded to Cining Hall to offer congratulations from afar to the empress dowager and present the patent and seal.

units.zh: 十二年八月，皇太后還慈寧宮，十月十八日，奉進冊寶。
units.en: In the eighth month of the twelfth year the empress dowager returned to Cining Palace. On the eighteenth day of the tenth month the patent and seal were formally presented.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the twelfth year, the empress dowager returned to Cining Palace; on the eighteenth day of the tenth month, the patent and seal were presented.

units.zh: 其日張設慈寧殿，設坐殿中，皇太后服禕衣即御坐，本殿官設冊寶於殿下， 慈寧宮事務官並本殿官並朝服詣殿下，再拜，搢笏，舉冊寶奉進；
units.en: On that day Cining Hall was prepared and a seat placed in the hall. The empress dowager, wearing the yi robe, took the imperial seat. Officials of the hall set the patent and seal below the hall. Officials in charge of Cining Palace affairs and hall officials alike, in court dress, proceeded below the hall, bowed twice, inserted their tablets, and raised the patent and seal to present them;
units.literal: On that day Cining Hall was set out; a seat was placed in the hall; the empress dowager, wearing the yi robe, immediately took the imperial seat; officials of the hall set the patent and seal below the hall; officials in charge of Cining Palace affairs and officials of the hall alike, in court dress, proceeded below the hall, bowed twice, inserted their tablets, raised the patent and seal and presented them;

units.zh: 先進冊，次進寶，進畢，降坐，易禕衣，服常服。
units.en: the patent was presented first and then the seal. When the presentation was complete, she left the seat, changed out of the yi robe, and put on ordinary dress.
units.literal: first the patent was presented, next the seal; when presentation was complete, she descended from the seat, changed out of the yi robe, and wore ordinary dress.

units.zh: 皇帝詣慈寧殿賀，如宮中儀，次宰臣率百僚拜表 稱賀。
units.en: The emperor proceeded to Cining Hall to offer congratulations according to inner-palace ceremony. Chief ministers then led all officials in bowing and submitting congratulatory memorials.
units.literal: The emperor proceeded to Cining Hall to offer congratulations, as in inner-palace ceremony; next chief ministers led the hundred officials in bowing and presenting memorials of congratulation.

units.zh: 三十二年六月，詔上太上皇帝、太上皇后尊號，集議以聞。
units.en: In the sixth month of the thirty-second year, an edict ordered honorific titles for the Supreme Emperor and Supreme Empress, and deliberations were assembled and reported.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the thirty-second year, an edict ordered that honorific titles be conferred on the Supreme Emperor and Supreme Empress; deliberations were assembled and reported.

units.zh: 左仆射陳康伯等言：“五帝之壽，惟堯最高，百王之聖，惟堯獨冠。
units.en: Left Vice Director Chen Kangbo and others said: "Among the Five Emperors, only Yao lived longest; among the hundred kings, only Yao stood supreme in sagely virtue.
units.literal: Left Vice Director Chen Kangbo and others said: "Among the Five Emperors in longevity, only Yao was highest; among the hundred kings in sageliness, only Yao stood alone at the crown.

units.zh: 今茲高世之舉， 視堯有光，恭請上太上皇帝尊號曰光堯壽聖太上皇帝，太上皇后尊號曰壽聖太上皇后。”
units.en: Now this exalted act surpassing the age shines when compared with Yao. We respectfully request conferring on the Supreme Emperor the honorific title Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor and on the Supreme Empress the honorific title Shousheng Supreme Empress."
units.literal: Now this exalted act surpassing the age sheds light when compared with Yao; we respectfully request conferring on the Supreme Emperor the honorific title Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor, and on the Supreme Empress the honorific title Shousheng Supreme Empress."

units.zh: 詔恭依，仍令禮部、太常討論禮儀以聞。
units.en: An edict respectfully approved the proposal and ordered the Ministry of Rites and the Temple of Rites to discuss the ceremonial regulations and report.
units.literal: An edict respectfully followed this, and still ordered the Ministry of Rites and the Temple of Rites to discuss ceremonial propriety and report.

units.zh: 左仆射陳康伯撰太上皇帝冊文，兼 禮儀使、參政汪澈書冊文並篆寶，知樞密院葉義問撰太上皇后冊文，同知樞密院事黃祖舜書冊文。
units.en: Left Vice Director Chen Kangbo drafted the Supreme Emperor's patent text. Concurrent Commissioner of Ceremonial Propriety and Vice Grand Councilor Wang Che inscribed the patent text and carved the seal in seal script. Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Ye Yiwen drafted the Supreme Empress's patent text, and Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Huang Zushun inscribed it.
units.literal: Left Vice Director Chen Kangbo drafted the Supreme Emperor's patent text; Concurrent Commissioner of Ceremonial Propriety and Vice Grand Councilor Wang Che inscribed the patent text and carved the seal in seal script; Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Ye Yiwen drafted the Supreme Empress's patent text; Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Huang Zushun inscribed the patent text.

units.zh: 八月十四日，奉上冊寶。
units.en: On the fourteenth day of the eighth month the patent and seal were presented.
units.literal: On the fourteenth day of the eighth month, the patent and seal were presented.

units.zh: 是日，陪位文武百僚、太傅以下行事官，並朝服入詣大慶殿下立班。
units.en: On that day civil and military officials attending in place and acting officials from the Grand Preceptor downward, all in court dress, entered and took their ranks below Daqing Hall.
units.literal: On that day, civil and military officials of the hundred ranks attending in place, and acting officials from the Grand Preceptor downward, all in court dress entered, proceeded below Daqing Hall, and stood in ranks.

units.zh: 皇帝自內服履袍入禦幄，服通天冠、絳紗袍出至大慶殿，詣冊寶褥位前再拜，在位官皆再拜訖，皇帝行發冊寶授太傅之禮如儀。
units.en: The emperor, wearing court robes within, entered the imperial curtain. Wearing the Tongtian cap and crimson gauze robe he came forth to Daqing Hall, proceeded to the patent and seal cushion, and bowed twice. After all officials in attendance had bowed twice, the emperor performed the rite of issuing the patent and seal and presenting them to the Grand Preceptor according to ceremony.
units.literal: The emperor, from within wearing court robes, entered the imperial curtain; wearing the Tongtian cap and crimson gauze robe he came forth to Daqing Hall, proceeded before the patent and seal cushion and bowed twice; when all officials in attendance had bowed twice, the emperor performed the rite of issuing the patent and seal and presenting them to the Grand Preceptor according to ceremony.

units.zh: 禮畢，皇帝還幄，服履袍還內，文武百僚退。
units.en: When the rites were complete, the emperor returned to the curtain, changed into court robes, and returned to the inner palace. Civil and military officials withdrew.
units.literal: When the rites were complete, the emperor returned to the curtain, changed into court robes, and returned within; civil and military officials of the hundred ranks withdrew.

units.zh: 儀仗鼓吹，
units.en: Guard of honor and ceremonial music,
units.literal: Guard of honor and ceremonial music,

units.zh: 〈（備而不作。）〉
units.en: (Prepared but not performed.)
units.literal: (Prepared but not performed.)

units.zh: 護衛冊寶，太傅以下行事官導從冊寶至德壽宮。
units.en: escorted the patent and seal as acting officials from the Grand Preceptor downward guided them to Deshou Palace.
units.literal: escorting the patent and seal, acting officials from the Grand Preceptor downward guided and followed the patent and seal to Deshou Palace.

units.zh: 皇帝自祥曦殿服履袍乘輦，至德壽宮大次降輦，陪位文武官入殿庭立班定，太傅以下行 事官從冊寶入殿，皇帝服通天冠、絳紗袍升殿，詣西向褥位立，太上皇帝自宮服履袍即坐，皇帝北向四拜起居訖，次太傅以下皆四拜起居。
units.en: The emperor, wearing court robes, rode the imperial carriage from Xiangxi Hall. At the great side hall of Deshou Palace he dismounted. Civil and military officials attending in place entered the hall court and took their fixed ranks. Acting officials from the Grand Preceptor downward followed the patent and seal into the hall. The emperor, wearing the Tongtian cap and crimson gauze robe, ascended the hall and stood at the western-facing cushion. The Supreme Emperor, wearing court robes within the palace, took his seat. The emperor, facing north, bowed four times in reporting on his health. The Grand Preceptor and those below then all bowed four times in reporting on health.
units.literal: The emperor, from Xiangxi Hall wearing court robes, rode the imperial carriage; arriving at the great side hall of Deshou Palace he descended from the carriage; civil and military officials attending in place entered the hall court and stood in fixed ranks; acting officials from the Grand Preceptor downward followed the patent and seal into the hall; the emperor, wearing the Tongtian cap and crimson gauze robe, ascended the hall, proceeded to the western-facing cushion and stood; the Supreme Emperor, from within the palace wearing court robes, immediately took his seat; the emperor, facing north, four times bowed in reporting on health; next the Grand Preceptor and below all four times bowed in reporting on health.

units.zh: 次行奉冊之 禮，中書令、參知政事史浩讀冊，攝侍中葉義問讀寶，讀訖，退復位。
units.en: Next came the rite of presenting the patent. Director of the Secretariat and Vice Grand Councilor Shi Hao read the patent, and Acting Palace Attendant Ye Yiwen read the seal. When the reading was finished, they withdrew and returned to their places.
units.literal: Next the rite of presenting the patent was performed; Director of the Secretariat and Vice Grand Councilor Shi Hao read the patent; Acting Palace Attendant Ye Yiwen read the seal; when reading was finished, they withdrew and returned to their places.

units.zh: 皇帝再拜稱賀曰：“皇帝臣某稽首言：伏惟光堯壽聖太上皇帝陛下冊寶告成，鴻名肇正，與天 同壽，率土均歡。”
units.en: The emperor bowed twice and offered congratulations, saying: "The emperor, your subject, kowtows and reports: Humbly considering that Your Majesty the Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor's patent and seal are now complete and the great name newly established, may you share Heaven's longevity; throughout the land all rejoice equally."
units.literal: The emperor bowed twice and offered congratulations, saying: "The emperor, your subject So-and-so, kowtows and says: Humbly considering that Your Majesty the Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor's patent and seal are announced complete, the great name is newly established, sharing Heaven's longevity; throughout the land all equally rejoice."

units.zh: 皇帝再拜，次侍中承旨宣答曰：“皇帝孝通天地，禮備古今，勉受鴻名，良深感慰。”
units.en: The emperor bowed twice. The Palace Attendant then received instructions and proclaimed the reply: "The emperor's filial piety reaches through Heaven and Earth and his rites are complete through past and present. I reluctantly accept this great name, and my gratitude and consolation are profound."
units.literal: The emperor bowed twice; next the Palace Attendant received instructions and proclaimed the reply: "The emperor's filial piety penetrates Heaven and Earth; rites are complete through past and present; I reluctantly accept the great name, and my feeling of deep consolation is truly great."

units.zh: 皇帝再拜訖，西向立，次太傅以下再拜稱賀致詞曰：“攝 太傅、尚書左仆射臣康伯等稽首言：伏惟光堯壽聖太上皇帝陛下肅臨寶位，誕受丕稱，獨推天父之尊，普慰帝臣之願。”
units.en: When the emperor had finished bowing twice, he stood facing west. The Grand Preceptor and those below then bowed twice and offered congratulations with a formal address: "Acting Grand Preceptor and Director of the Left Secretariat, your subject Kangbo and others kowtow and report: Humbly considering that Your Majesty the Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor solemnly presides over the throne and has newly received this great title, uniquely extending the honor due Heaven's father and universally fulfilling the wishes of the emperor's ministers."
units.literal: When the emperor had finished bowing twice, he stood facing west; next the Grand Preceptor and below bowed twice and offered congratulations with a formal address, saying: "Acting Grand Preceptor, Director of the Left Secretariat, your subject Kangbo and others kowtow and say: Humbly considering that Your Majesty the Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor solemnly presides over the precious throne, newly receives the great title, uniquely extending the honor of Heaven's father, universally comforting the wishes of the emperor's ministers."

units.zh: 奏訖，再拜舞蹈。
units.en: When the address was finished, they bowed twice and performed the dance.
units.literal: When the memorial was finished, they bowed twice and performed the dance.

units.zh: 次侍中承旨宣答曰：“光 堯壽聖太上皇帝聖旨：倦勤滋久，佚老是圖，勉受嘉名，但增感慰。”
units.en: The Palace Attendant then received instructions and proclaimed the reply: "The Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor's edict: Weariness in diligence has long grown; retirement and old age are my aim. I reluctantly accept this fine name, but my gratitude and consolation only increase."
units.literal: Next the Palace Attendant received instructions and proclaimed the reply: "The Guangyao Shousheng Supreme Emperor's holy edict: Weariness in diligence has long increased; retirement and old age are my aim; I reluctantly accept the fine name, but my feeling of gratitude and consolation only increases."

units.zh: 又再拜舞蹈。
units.en: Again they bowed twice and performed the dance.
units.literal: Again they bowed twice and performed the dance.

units.zh: 次太上皇帝降坐入宮，皇帝後從壽聖太上皇后冊寶入宮。
units.en: Next the Supreme Emperor left his seat and entered the palace. The emperor followed with the Shousheng Supreme Empress's patent and seal into the palace.
units.literal: Next the Supreme Emperor descended from the seat and entered the palace; the emperor followed afterward with the Shousheng Supreme Empress's patent and seal into the palace.

units.zh: 皇帝詣太 上皇后坐前北向立，太上皇后升坐，皇帝四拜起居，行奉上冊寶之禮，讀冊官陳子常讀冊，讀寶官梁康民讀寶，讀訖復位，皇帝再拜稱賀致詞曰：“皇帝臣某稽首 言：伏惟壽聖太上皇后殿下德茂坤元，禮崇大號，寶書翕受，歡抃無疆。”
units.en: The emperor proceeded before the Supreme Empress's seat and stood facing north. The Supreme Empress ascended and took her seat. The emperor bowed four times in reporting on her health and performed the rite of presenting the patent and seal. Patent Reader Chen Zichang read the patent and Seal Reader Liang Kangmin read the seal; when the reading was finished they returned to their places. The emperor bowed twice and offered congratulations with a formal address: "The emperor, your subject, kowtows and reports: Humbly considering that Your Highness the Shousheng Supreme Empress's virtue flourishes in the earth's origin and rites honor this great title, the precious document is graciously received and our joy knows no bounds."
units.literal: The emperor proceeded before the Supreme Empress's seat and stood facing north; the Supreme Empress ascended and took her seat; the emperor four times bowed in reporting on health; the rite of presenting the patent and seal was performed; Patent Reader Chen Zichang read the patent; Seal Reader Liang Kangmin read the seal; when reading was finished they returned to their places; the emperor bowed twice and offered congratulations with a formal address, saying: "The emperor, your subject So-and-so, kowtows and says: Humbly considering that Your Highness the Shousheng Supreme Empress's virtue flourishes in the earth's origin, rites honor the great title, the precious document is harmoniously received; joyful exultation is without bound."

units.zh: 皇帝再拜，次宣答官承旨宣答曰：“壽聖太上皇后教旨：皇帝祲容載蕆，顯號來膺，誠孝 通天，但深感惕。”
units.en: The emperor bowed twice. The reply-proclaiming official then received instructions and proclaimed the reply: "The Shousheng Supreme Empress's instruction: The emperor's reverent bearing carries deep sincerity; the illustrious title comes to be received; his sincere filial piety reaches through Heaven—but my feeling of deep reverence and caution is profound."
units.literal: The emperor bowed twice; next the reply-proclaiming official received instructions and proclaimed the reply: "The Shousheng Supreme Empress's instruction: The emperor's reverent bearing carries deep sincerity; the illustrious title comes to be received; sincere filial piety penetrates Heaven; but my feeling of deep reverence and caution is great."

units.zh: 皇帝再拜訖，太上皇后降坐入宮。
units.en: When the emperor had finished bowing twice, the Supreme Empress left her seat and entered the palace.
units.literal: When the emperor had finished bowing twice, the Supreme Empress descended from the seat and entered the palace.

units.zh: 次太傅以下文武百僚就德壽殿下拜箋稱賀以俟，皇帝服履袍乘輦還內。
units.en: Next civil and military officials from the Grand Preceptor downward, below Deshou Hall, bowed and submitted letters of congratulation to wait. The emperor, wearing court robes, rode the imperial carriage and returned to the inner palace.
units.literal: Next civil and military officials of the hundred ranks from the Grand Preceptor downward, below Deshou Hall, bowed and submitted letters of congratulation to wait; the emperor, wearing court robes, rode the imperial carriage and returned within.

units.zh: 十六日，宰臣率文武百僚詣文德殿拜表 稱賀。
units.en: On the sixteenth day chief ministers led all civil and military officials to Wende Hall to bow and submit congratulatory memorials.
units.literal: On the sixteenth day, chief ministers led civil and military officials of the hundred ranks to proceed to Wende Hall, bow, and present memorials of congratulation.

units.zh: 英宗體乾應曆隆功盛德憲文肅武睿聖宣孝皇帝，諱曙，濮安懿王允讓第十三子，母曰仙游縣君任氏。
units.en: Emperor Yingzong—full style from Aligning with Heaven through Proclaiming Filiality—personal name Shu, was the thirteenth son of Prince of Pu’an Yunrang; his mother was Lady Ren of Xianyou.
units.literal: Emperor Yingzong, entitled Aligning with Heaven, Responding to the Calendar, Lofty Merit, Abundant Virtue, Constituting Culture, Solemn Martiality, Sagacious Governance, Proclaiming Filiality, taboo name Shu, was the thirteenth son of Prince of Pu’an the Respectful Wang Yunrang; his mother was Lady Ren, county mistress of Xianyou.

units.zh: 諡曰憲文肅武宣孝皇帝，廟號英宗。
units.en: Posthumous name: Sagacious Governance, Solemn Martiality, Proclaiming Filiality; temple name Yingzong.
units.literal: Posthumous title: Sagacious Governance, Solemn Martiality, Proclaiming Filiality Emperor; temple name Yingzong.

units.zh: 英宗以明哲之資，膺繼統之命，執心固讓，若將終身，而卒踐帝位，豈非天命乎？
units.en: Yingzong's clear mind took the succession yet he refused as if for life—and still became emperor. Was that not Heaven's mandate?
units.literal: Yingzong with his clear wisdom received the mandate to succeed, yet steadfastly declined as if for life, yet in the end ascended the throne—is this not Heaven's mandate?

units.zh: 癸未，改今名。
units.en: On guiwei, he received his present name Shu.
units.literal: Day guiwei: his present name was given.

units.zh: 景祐三年，賜名宗實，授左監門衛率府副率，累遷右羽林軍大將軍、宜州刺史。
units.en: In Jingyou 3 he received the name Zongshi and was appointed deputy commandant in the Left Palace Gate Guard; he later rose to Great General of the Right Feathered Forest Army and prefectural military commissioner of Yi Prefecture.
units.literal: In the third year of Jingyou he was given the name Zongshi and appointed deputy commandant of the Left Palace Gate Guard command, later rising through the ranks to Great General of the Right Feathered Forest Army and prefectural military commissioner of Yi Prefecture.

units.zh: 夏四月壬申朔，皇后傳遺詔，命帝嗣皇帝位。
units.en: Fourth month, new moon renshen: the empress’s will made him emperor.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renshen new moon: the empress transmitted the testament and ordered the emperor to succeed to the throne.

units.zh: 戊寅，立爲皇子。
units.en: On wuyin, he was made imperial son.
units.literal: Day wuyin: he was established as imperial son.

units.zh: 辛巳，詔臣民避濮安懿王諱，以王子宗懿爲濮國公。
units.en: On xinsi, Pu Yi's taboo was proclaimed and Zongyi made Duke of Pu.
units.literal: Day xinsi, edict: the people were to avoid the taboo of Prince of Pu'an Yi; his son Zongyi was made Duke of Pu.

units.zh: 丁亥，以皇子右千牛衛將軍仲鍼爲安州觀察使、光國公。
units.en: On dinghai, Zhongzhen became An commissioner and Duke of Guangguo.
units.literal: Day dinghai: the imperial son’s right thousand-oxen general Zhongzhen was made observation commissioner of An and Duke of Guangguo.

units.zh: 六月己亥，以淮陽郡王頊爲潁王，祁國公顥爲保甯軍節度使、同中書門下平章事、東陽郡王，鄠國公頵爲左衛上將軍。
units.en: Sixth month, jihai: Xu became Ying prince; Hao became Baoning commissioner and Dongyang prince; Yun became left guard senior general.
units.literal: Sixth month, day jihai: Prince of Huaiyang Xu was made Prince of Ying; Duke of Qi Guo Hao was made Baoning military commissioner, co-chancellor, Prince of Dongyang; Duke of E Guo Yun was made left guard senior general.

units.zh: 庚子，立京兆郡君高氏爲皇后。
units.en: On gengzi, Lady Gao of Jingzhao became empress.
units.literal: Day gengzi: Lady Gao of Jingzhao commandery was established as empress.

units.zh: 明道元年正月三日生於宣平坊第。
units.en: Bright Path 1, third of the first month: he was born at the Xuanping mansion.
units.literal: In the first year of Bright Path, first month, third day, he was born at the Xuanping ward residence.

units.zh: 寶元二年，豫王生，乃歸濮邸。
units.en: Precious Origin 2, when Prince Yu was born, he returned to the Pu mansion.
units.literal: In the second year of Precious Origin, when Prince Yu was born, he returned to the Pu residence.

units.zh: 皇祐二年，爲右衛大將軍、岳州團練使。
units.en: Imperial Blessing 2: right guard general and Yue commander.
units.literal: In the second year of Imperial Blessing he was great general of the right guard and regimental commander of Yue prefecture.

units.zh: 嘉祐中，宰相韓琦等請建儲，仁宗曰：「宗子已有賢知可付者，卿等其勿憂。」
units.en: Jiayou: Han Qi urged naming an heir; Renzong said, "Among the imperial sons there is already one of worthy knowledge who can be entrusted—you need not worry."
units.literal: In the Jiayou era chief minister Han Qi and others asked to establish an heir; Renzong said: “Among the imperial sons there is already one of worthy knowledge who can be entrusted—you need not worry.”

units.zh: 六年十月辛卯，起爲秦州防禦使、知宗正寺，帝以終喪辭。
units.en: Year six, tenth month, xinmao: he was recalled as defense commissioner of Qin Prefecture and administrator of the Court of the Imperial Clan, but declined because his mourning was not complete.
units.literal: Sixth year, tenth month, day xinmao: he was raised as defense commissioner of Qin and director of the imperial clan court; the emperor declined on grounds of unfinished mourning.

units.zh: 七年八月，許罷宗正，復爲岳州團練使。
units.en: Year seven, eighth month: he left the clan court and returned to Yue command.
units.literal: Seventh year, eighth month: he was permitted to leave the clan court and again became regimental commander of Yue.

units.zh: 八年，仁宗崩。
units.en: Year eight: Renzong died.
units.literal: Year eight: Renzong died.

units.zh: 治平元年春正月丁酉朔，改元。
units.en: Zhiping 1, first month new moon dingyou: a new reign era began.
units.literal: Zhiping 1, spring, first month, day dingyou new moon: the era name was changed.

units.zh: 二年春正月甲戌，振蔡州。
units.en: Year two, first month, jiaxu: Cai was relieved.
units.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day jiaxu: Cai prefecture was relieved.

units.zh: 三年春正月丙辰朔，契丹遣使耶律仲達等來賀正旦。
units.en: Year three, first month new moon bingchen: Khitan envoys came for New Year's Day.
units.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day bingchen new moon: Khitan sent envoy Yelü Zhongda and others to congratulate New Year's Day.

units.zh: 四年春正月庚戌朔，群臣上尊號曰體乾膺曆文武聖孝皇帝。
units.en: Year four, first month new moon gengxu: ministers offered the full honorific title.
units.literal: Year four, spring, first month, day gengxu new moon: the bureaucracy offered the honorific From Heaven, Receiving the Calendar, Civil and Military, Sagely Filial Emperor.

units.zh: 丁巳，帝崩于福甯殿，壽三十六。
units.en: On dingsi, he died in Funing Hall at thirty-six.
units.literal: Day dingsi: the emperor died in Funing Hall; age thirty-six.

units.zh: 九月，遷齊州防禦使、鉅鹿郡公。
units.en: Ninth month: he became Qi defense commissioner and Duke of Julu.
units.literal: Ninth month: he was moved to defense commissioner of Qi and Duke of Julu.

units.zh: 帝自居睦親宅，孝德著聞。
units.en: In the Mujin mansion his filial piety was legendary.
units.literal: When the emperor lived at the Mujin residence, filial virtue was renowned.

units.zh: 冬十月甲午，葬仁宗於永昭陵。
units.en: Tenth month, jiawu: Renzong was buried at Yongzhao.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiawu: Renzong was buried at Yongzhao Tomb.

units.zh: 四歲，仁宗養於內。
units.en: At four he was raised in the palace by Renzong.
units.literal: At four sui he was raised in the inner palace by Renzong.

units.zh: 帝欲亮陰三年，命韓琦攝冢宰，宰臣不可，乃止。
units.en: He wanted three years of mourning; Han Qi as acting ritual chief was blocked by the cabinet.
units.literal: The emperor wished three years of bright mourning; Han Qi was ordered acting chief of rites; chief ministers objected and it was stopped.

units.zh: 乙亥，帝不豫。
units.en: On yihai, the emperor sickened.
units.literal: Day yihai: the emperor was unwell.

units.zh: 己卯，詔請皇太后同聽政。
units.en: On jimao, the dowager was asked to co-rule.
units.literal: Day jimao, edict: the empress dowager was asked to hear government jointly.

units.zh: 夏四月戊戌，詔議崇奉濮安懿王典禮。
units.en: Fourth month, wuxu: the court was to debate rites for Prince of Pu'an Yi.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuxu, edict: rites for honoring Prince of Pu'an Yi were to be debated.

units.zh: 丁丑，皇太后下書中書門下：「封濮安懿王宜如前代故事，王夫人王氏、韓氏、任氏，皇帝可稱親。
units.en: On dingchou, the dowager wrote: "Enfeoff Pu Yi by ancient precedent; the emperor might call Wang, Han, and Ren kin.
units.literal: Day dingchou: the empress dowager sent a letter to the Secretariat and Chancellor's Office: "Enfeoffment of Prince of Pu'an Yi should follow former-age precedent; Madames Wang, Han, and Ren—the emperor may call them kin.

units.zh: 帝書其後曰：「雨災專以戒朕不德，可更曰'協德交修'。」
units.en: He added in his own hand: "The rain warns only my want of virtue—say instead that we will cultivate virtue together."
units.literal: The emperor wrote after it: "The rain disaster is solely to warn me of lack of virtue—it should rather read 'join in cultivating virtue.'"

units.zh: 每以朝服見教授，曰：「師也，敢弗爲禮？」
units.en: Meeting his tutor in court dress he said, “You are my teacher—I must show full ritual.”
units.literal: Whenever he met his tutor in court dress he said: “You are my teacher—how dare I not show ritual?”

units.zh: 戊辰，謂宰相曰：「朕欲與公等日論治道，中書常務有定制者，付有司行之。」
units.en: On wuchen he told the cabinet: "Let us debate governance daily; routine papers can go to the clerks."
units.literal: Day wuchen: he told the chief ministers: "I wish to discuss the way of rule with you daily; routine Secretariat business with fixed regulations may be handed to the offices."

units.zh: 宗室有假金帶而以銅帶歸，主吏以告，帝曰：「真吾帶也。」
units.en: A kinsman swapped a gold belt for copper; told of it, he said, "That is my belt."
units.literal: A clansman borrowed a gold belt and returned a copper one; the steward reported it, and the emperor said: "That is truly my belt."

units.zh: 奏十餘不允，始就召，戒舍人曰：「謹守吾舍，上有適嗣，吾歸矣。」
units.en: Ten refusals failed before he answered the call, telling staff: "Guard my rooms—an heir exists; I go home."
units.literal: More than ten memorials went unheeded before he accepted the summons; he warned the palace staff: "Guard my quarters carefully—there is already a proper heir; I am going home."

units.zh: 即位，每命近臣，必以官而不以名，大臣從容以爲言，帝曰：「朕雖宮中命小臣，亦未嘗以名也。」
units.en: He addressed even close attendants by office, not name—"Even palace pages get titles from me," he told the ministers.
units.literal: On succeeding to the throne, whenever he ordered a close attendant he used title, never personal name; when chief ministers gently remonstrated, the emperor said: "Even when I order a minor palace servant within, I never use the name."

units.zh: 奏四上，乃聽。
units.en: Four memorials later, he was allowed to refuse.
units.literal: He memorialized four times; only then was he heard.

units.zh: 帝聞詔稱疾，益堅辭。
units.en: On hearing the edict he pleaded illness and refused harder.
units.literal: Hearing the edict, he claimed illness and declined more firmly.

units.zh: 一日，語神宗曰：「國家舊制，士大夫之子有尚帝女，皆升行以避舅姑之尊，義甚無謂。
units.en: He told Shenzong, "By old custom, when sons-in-law were promoted in rank to dodge a mother-in-law's seniority—it was a senseless twist of kinship.
units.literal: One day he said to Emperor Shenzong: "By old custom, when a scholar's son marries an imperial daughter, his rank is raised to avoid the mother-in-law's seniority—a meaningless twist of kinship.

units.zh: 朕嘗思此，寤寐不平，豈可以富貴之故，屈人倫長幼之序也？
units.en: I have brooded on it—how can wealth warp the order of elders and juniors?
units.literal: I have brooded on this, uneasy waking and sleeping—how can we bend the order of elder and younger for wealth and rank?

units.zh: 可詔有司革之。」
units.en: Let the offices reform it."
units.literal: Let the authorities reform it."

units.zh: 帝天性篤孝，好讀書，不爲燕嬉褻慢，服御儉素如儒者。
units.en: He was deeply filial, bookish, never frivolous or rude, and dressed as plainly as a scholar.
units.literal: By nature he was deeply filial, loved reading, did not indulge in frivolous amusement or disrespect, and dressed plainly like a scholar.

units.zh: 既爲皇子，慎靜恭默，無所猷爲，而天下陰知其有聖德。
units.en: As imperial son he was stillness itself, yet the realm sensed his sage virtue.
units.literal: Once imperial son, he was cautious, quiet, and reserved, doing nothing ostentatious, yet the empire quietly knew he bore sage virtue.

units.zh: 及其臨政，臣下有奏，必問朝廷故事與古治所宜，每有裁決，皆出群臣意表。
units.en: In power he asked every memorial what precedent and antiquity required; his judgments consistently surprised the court.
units.literal: When he held government, whenever ministers memorialized he asked what court precedent and ancient governance required; each decision went beyond what ministers expected.

units.zh: 時吳王宮教授吳充進《宗室六箴》，仁宗付宗正，帝書之屏風以自戒。
units.en: Wu Chong’s Six Admonitions for the Clan were set on his screen as a daily warning.
units.literal: At the time Wu Chong, tutor of the Wu prince’s palace, presented the Six Admonitions for the Imperial Clan; Renzong gave them to the clan court and the emperor wrote them on a screen for self-warning.

units.zh: 命殿侍鬻犀帶，直錢三十萬，亡之，帝亦不問。
units.en: He had a rhinoceros belt sold for three hundred thousand; when it vanished, he never asked.
units.literal: He ordered a hall attendant to sell a rhinoceros belt worth three hundred thousand cash; it was lost, and the emperor did not inquire.

units.zh: 上再三稱善，且曰：「僖祖自不當祧，高宗即位時不曾祧，壽皇即位，太上即位，亦不曾祧，今日豈可容易？
units.en: The emperor repeatedly expressed approval and said: "Emperor Xi ought not to be removed; when Gaozong ascended the throne he was not removed, when Emperor Xiaozong ascended, when the Retired Emperor ascended, he was likewise not removed—how can this be done lightly today?
units.literal: The emperor repeatedly expressed approval and said: "Emperor Xi ought not to be removed; when Gaozong ascended the throne he was not removed, when Emperor Xiaozong ascended, when the Retired Emperor ascended, he was likewise not removed—how can this be done lightly today?

units.zh: 及光宗祔廟，遂復為九世十二室。
units.en: When Guangzong's tablet was installed, it again became nine generations and twelve shrines.
units.literal: When Guangzong's tablet was installed, it again became nine generations and twelve shrines.

units.zh: 授右迪功郎、禮、兵部架閣，以御史葉義問劾之，改監潭州南嶽廟，給劄歸抄所著《通志》。
units.en: He was made Right Junior Merit Officer and war and rites archivist; Censor Ye Yiwen attacked him, so he became superintendent of Tanzhou's Southern Mountain temple, with orders to go home and copy his 《Comprehensive Treatises》.
units.literal: He was appointed Right Junior Merit Officer and Archivist in the Ministries of Rites and War; the censor Ye Yiwen impeached him, and he was changed to Superintendent of the Southern Mountain Temple at Tanzhou, with a patent to return and copy his work 《Comprehensive Treatises》.

units.zh: 十一月乙丑，命韓絳制置三司條例。
units.en: Eleventh month, yichou: Han Jiang took the New Policies office.
units.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou: Han Jiang was made director of the Three Departments Regulations Office.

units.zh: 太 宗、仁宗、神宗南向為昭，真宗、英宗、哲宗北向為穆。
units.en: Taizong, Renzong, and Shenzong should face south as zhao; Zhenzong, Yingzong, and Zhezong north as mu.
units.literal: Taizong, Renzong, and Shenzong should face south as zhao; Zhenzong, Yingzong, and Zhezong should face north as mu.

units.zh: 高宗將迎韋太后於郊，因製常行儀仗，用黃麾仗二千二百六十五人。
units.en: When Emperor Gaozong prepared to welcome Empress Dowager Wei at the suburbs, he established routine traveling ceremonial regalia using 2,265 men of the yellow-command guard.
units.literal: When Emperor Gaozong was about to welcome Empress Dowager Wei at the suburbs, he therefore established routine traveling ceremonial regalia, using the yellow-command guard of two thousand two hundred sixty-five men.

units.zh: 太上皇儀衛。
units.en: Ceremonial Guards for the Retired Emperor.
units.literal: Retired Emperor ceremonial guards.

units.zh: 先是，紹興三十二年六月，詔：“上皇日常朝殿，差禦龍直四十三人，執仗排立，並設傘扇，鳴鞭。
units.en: Earlier, in the sixth month of Shaoxing 32, an edict stated: "For the Retired Emperor's daily audience, detail forty-three Imperial Dragon Direct to stand in ranks bearing weapons, with parasols and fans deployed and the ceremonial whip sounded.
units.literal: Earlier, in the sixth month of the thirty-second year of Shaoxing, an edict stated: "For the Retired Emperor's daily audience in the hall, forty-three Imperial Dragon Direct were detailed, bearing weapons and standing in ranks, with parasols and fans set out and the whip sounded.

units.zh: 兩奉上皇旨，卻而不受，故復有是詔。
units.en: The Retired Emperor declined twice, which led to this renewed edict.
units.literal: Twice the edict was presented to the Retired Emperor, and twice he declined it, and so this edict was issued again.

units.zh: 今父堯子舜，事親典禮，凡往古來今所未備者，當以義起，極其尊崇，為萬世法。”
units.en: With a filial son like Shun honoring a sage father like Yao, rites not provided for in past or present should be established on principle, carried to the highest honor, and made a model for all time."
units.literal: Now, with a father as Yao and a son as Shun, the rites of honoring parents—wherever past and present had not provided for them—should be initiated according to principle, carried to the utmost honor, and made a law for ten thousand generations."

units.zh: 邑有宋趙抃所鑿溝，溉民田數千畝。
units.en: The district had a canal dug by Zhao Bian of the Song, which irrigated several thousand mu of farmland.
units.literal: In the district was a canal dug by Zhao Bian of Song, irrigating several thousand mu of the people's fields.

units.zh: 伯顏修長溝十里，繞楓樹陂，累石以為固，溝悉复抃遺跡，而田為常稔，民賴其利。
units.en: Boyan restored the long canal for ten li, routing it around Maple Tree Dam and reinforcing it with stone; the watercourse fully recovered Bian's original layout, the fields yielded reliably again, and the people prospered from it.
units.literal: Boyan repaired the long canal for ten li, winding around Maple Tree Dam, piling stones to make it firm; the canal fully restored Bian's original course, the fields became consistently fertile, and the people relied on the benefit.

units.zh: 太宗以十月七日為乾明節，復改為壽寧節。
units.en: Taizong’s birthday was observed on the seventh day of the tenth month as the Qianming Festival, later renamed the Shouning Festival.
units.literal: Taizong took the seventh day of the tenth month as the Qianming Festival, which was later changed to the Shouning Festival.
